task: put the bowl on top of the cabinet

windows.text: Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the bowl.
Approach the bowl from above, lowering the open gripper toward its rim.
Approach the bowl from above, lowering the open gripper down toward its rim.
Grasp the bowl on the table by closing the gripper fingers around its rim.
Grasp the bowl on the table and lift it upward.
Lift the bowl up off the table, raising it above the black bottle.
Lift the bowl up off the table, raising it above the black bottle.
Carry the bowl horizontally toward the dark cabinet, moving it over the wooden slats.
Release the bowl onto the top surface of the cabinet.
Release the bowl onto the top of the cabinet and retract the empty gripper upward.
